punchline: In Taleb's story, the turkey is most confident of all on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving.
thirty_sec: A turkey is fed by the farmer every day for a thousand days. Each meal makes it more sure that people are looking out for it. On the Wednesday before Thanksgiving, everything changes. Taleb uses the turkey to show that a long calm record says little about a large event that has not happened yet, just as centuries of white swans said nothing about the black ones in Australia.
